title: LookBenchmark
description: Data file content/look/benchmark.json: the FPS benchmark of the island scene (B2-7, acceptance 5, R30). A fixed world, a crowd of placeholder figures for the presentation only (never in the core or the state hash), a camera path and one pass per look (day phase, season, weather). Presentation only.

seed.description: World seed of the benchmark island (fixed, so every run shows the same world).

revealed_permille.description: Share of the land shown as seen (cloud cover lifted) for the whole benchmark, in permille (A1559, TL #21633: the measurement shows the game with the island explored - the heavy case). Omitted = the cover as the start world has it (most of the island under clouds).

warmup_s.description: Real seconds before each pass is measured (the look of the pass is already shown).

duration_s.description: Real seconds each pass is measured; the camera path is stretched to this length.

target_mean_fps.description: Pass mark for the summary line: mean frames per second at least this.

target_p95_frame_ms.description: Pass mark for the summary line: 95th percentile of the frame time at most this.

camera.description: Camera path keys in time order; between two keys every value runs linearly.

passes.description: The passes in the order a full run measures them.

BenchmarkCrowd.description: Placeholder figures around the first inhabitant, drawn like inhabitants (same figure, clips and cadence), driven by the benchmark only.

count.description: Number of placeholder figures (the inhabitants of the world come on top).

spacing_m.description: Distance between two neighbouring home spots (sunflower pattern on land).

walk_radius_m.description: Radius of the circle a walking figure walks around its home spot.

walk_speed_m_s.description: Walking speed on screen in metres per real second.

walk_gait.description: Gait id of the animation library the walking figures play.

action_change_s.description: Real seconds a standing figure keeps one action of its group before the next.

groups.description: The mix: each figure belongs to one group, spread by weight over the crowd.

weight.description: Share of the crowd relative to the other groups.

walks.description: True: the figures walk their circle; false: they stand at their home spot.

actions.description: Core action ids (mappings of kind action in content/animation/library.json), taken in turn.

wave_s.description: Optional: seconds the figure waves at each change of action (expressions).

talk_s.description: Optional: seconds the figure talks (mouth) at each change of action (expressions).

at_s.description: Time of the key within a pass of duration_s seconds (scaled with a shorter or longer duration).

yaw_deg.description: Camera yaw; not wrapped, so 0 to 360 is one full turn.

distance_m.description: Distance of the camera from its target (clamped to content/look/camera.json).

follow.description: Optional: index of a walking crowd figure the target follows; without it the target is the crowd centre.

id.description: Pass id (--bench-pass=ID, column pass of the CSV).

weather.description: Weather shown (content/look/weather.json): clouds, light, rain, snow, snow cover.

wind_permille.description: Wind 0..1000 the plants, waves and particles move with (as wind_permille of the climate).

epoch.description: Optional: look epoch shown; without it the epoch of the world.
